newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5426/5436 FXSU.
newsitem.headline: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5426/5436 FXSU.

text.p: The Russian Central Bank said it had set 5426/5436 roubles per dollar as its bid and offer rates for its operations on the currency market on Monday.
The official rate for Tuesday will be 5431.
On Friday the bid/offer rates were 5424/5434, with the official dollar rate 5429 from Saturday.
The Central Bank announces daily bid/offer dollar/rouble rates for its currency operations. The midpoint of these rates is the official dollar/rouble rate for the following day.
The daily corridor for the rouble on the interbank market is 5287/5887 after 5284/5884.
